<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M⁺ 114.068 Da) the molecular formula is C₆H₁₀O₂ (DBE = 2). The IR shows a carbonyl stretch at 1729 cm⁻¹, an OH stretch at 3446 cm⁻¹, and a C=C stretch at 1656 cm⁻¹, indicating a molecule that contains an aldehyde (or ester) carbonyl, an alkene, and a free hydroxyl group. A structure that satisfies all these features and the formula is 4‑hydroxy‑2‑hexenal (HO‑CH₂‑CH₂‑CH=CH‑CHO). Its SMILES representation is **O=CCCC=CCO**, which gives C₆H₁₀O₂, one aldehyde carbonyl, one C=C double bond, and a terminal alcohol. This matches the observed spectroscopic data.</thought>
<final_answer>O=CCCC=CCO</final_answer>
